summary: Comprehensive testing of DJ flow - DJ login, check-in, Social Wall integration, DMs, and checkout. All 17 backend tests passed. Frontend UI flow verified with Playwright - DJ can login, check-in at location, view Vibe Wall, and users can DM the DJ.
seed_data_creation: Created test DJs (TEST_DJ_Flow, TEST_DJ_SongReq, Test DJ Playwright) during testing - cleaned up after tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: DJ flow fully tested and working. DJ login, check-in, Social Wall navigation, DM functionality, and checkout all verified.

dj_login.test: DJ login with name creates/retrieves profile

dj_next_session_live.test: Returns is_live: true when DJ is checked in

checkin_includes_dj.test: Includes checked-in DJ with 'DJ ...' display name and '🎵 Live DJ' mood

wall_users_includes_dj.test: Includes checked-in DJ so users can DM them

dj_at_location.test: Returns DJ info when checked in

dj_checkout.test: DJ checkout removes them from location

song_request.test: Submit song request when DJ is live

scheduled_dj_names.test: Returns list of scheduled DJ names

dj_login_page.test: DJ login page loads with existing DJ name buttons
dj_login_page.details: Found 13 existing DJ name buttons (DJ 2TIMES, DJ AHA, DJ DB, etc.)

dj_location_select.test: After login, location select screen shows all locations
dj_location_select.details: Shows 8 locations including Edgewood, Midtown, Douglasville, etc.

dj_dashboard.test: DJ Dashboard shows when checked in
dj_dashboard.details: Shows 'VIEW VIBE WALL & CHAT' button, Karaoke Mode, Go Live, Tip Payment Links

navigate_to_social_wall.test: Clicking 'View Vibe Wall & Chat' navigates to /social/{location_slug}

dj_status_live_banner.test: Social Wall shows 'LIVE NOW' banner with DJ name

dj_in_checkins.test: DJ appears in 'Who's Here' tab with '🎵 Live DJ' mood
dj_in_checkins.details: Shows 'DJ TEST DJ PLAYWRIGHT' with 'Live DJ' mood

song_request_button.test: Feed tab shows 'Song' post type button when DJ is live

dj_in_dm_contacts.test: DMs tab 'New DM' shows checked-in DJ as contact
dj_in_dm_contacts.details: Found 4 users in DM list including DJ
